limits: 194 definitions include templates, stations, missiles, debris and subentities; not 194 unique ships.
NPC auto_weapons, fuzzy equipment, shield upgrades and OXP overrides can modify spawned capabilities.
Player shield pools differ from NPC energy; NPC energy must not be relabelled player shield strength.
Model bounds are numerical envelopes, not internal hull volume. Absolute physical model scale not independently verified; volume ratios are safe only within a consistent model-unit profile.
Shipyard standard equipment is distinct from maximum supported capacity and NPC loadout.

player_weapon_semantics.comment_disagreement: currentWeaponStats says recharge rate unused, but controls gate firing on shot_time > weapon_recharge_rate. Executable logic takes precedence.
player_weapon_semantics.on_success: Deduct energy use times barrel count; add heat per shot times count; reset selected-facing elapsed shot timer.
player_weapon_semantics.clock: delta_t simulation domain; real-time frame/input cadence and runtime parity still require fixtures

player_shield_recharge_semantics.source_routine: PlayerEntity.m update energy and shield charges
player_shield_recharge_semantics.priority: Lower absolute shield first; equal values give aft first.
player_shield_recharge_semantics.algorithm: Add generator energy*delta_t; cap each desired shield recharge by missing capacity. If both shields above critical fraction, allocate max(0,energy-0.1-maxEnergy*configured_threshold), otherwise all energy. Allocate lower shield first, then other; deduct total recharge from energy; clamp pools.

inheritance_semantics: O08 OOShipRegistry.mergeShip removes like_ship and non-inherited display_name/is_template, and selects child aliases for scan class, escort role/ship, carrier and shipyard. Own dictionaries remain original source fields; runtime defaults/equipment remain separate.
